Activatespawner.name: Activatespawner

attributes.description: The name of the spawner(s) to activate. This can accept groups and wildcards also using the appropriate syntax

Add Trade.name: Add Trade
Add Trade.description: Changes the trades of a villager. The villager will become a nitwit if it doesn't have any profession assigned when using this mechanic.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: The action to perform. Can be ADD, REMOVE,REPLACE

attributes.name: slot
attributes.description: The slot to be selected for the action. Slot starts at 0, so if a villager has 3 trades, the middle trade would be slot 1

attributes.name: ingredient
attributes.description: The first ingredient

attributes.name: ingredient2
attributes.description: The second ingredient

attributes.name: result
attributes.description: The result item of the trade

attributes.name: maxUses
attributes.description: The uses of the trade

attributes.name: experienceReward
attributes.description: If the trade should drop experience

attributes.name: villagerExp
attributes.description: The amount of experience to give to the villager upon successful trade

attributes.name: priceMultiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier for the price when the player has made the villager angry

attributes.name: demand
attributes.description: The demand of the trade

attributes.name: specialPrice
attributes.description: The special price for when the villager is friendly to the player (player reputation or hero of the village effect)

Aura.name: Aura
Aura.description: The Aura mechanic acts as a status effect on the target entity, and can trigger other skills over its duration. Auras allow you to create custom status effects (i.e. buffs and debuffs) that are tracked for their duration and can also be used in other mechanics and conditions.

attributes.name: auraName
attributes.description: Optional name, required to use associated mechanics & conditions that reference a specific aura. Given a random UUID if not defined.

attributes.name: components
attributes.description: The aura components to apply. Better explained later in the page

attributes.name: auratype
attributes.description: The type of the aura. It's similar to its name

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: A list of comma-separated tags that the aura will have. The tags do nothing on their own, but can be used to "mark" the aura and better check against it

attributes.name: attachmenttype
attributes.description: The Attachment to apply to the entity the aura is applied to

attributes.name: onStartSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the aura first starts

attributes.name: onTickSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed every [interval] ticks on the affected entity

attributes.name: onEndSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the aura ends

attributes.name: ShowBarTimer
attributes.description: If set, the aura will display a bar for caster during it

attributes.name: Charges
attributes.description: If set, the aura will fade when it hits zero charges. Modifiable by other mechanics.

attributes.name: Duration
attributes.description: The max duration (in ticks) the aura will persist.

attributes.name: Interval
attributes.description: How often (in ticks) the aura fires its onTick skill

attributes.name: maxStacks
attributes.description: How many times the aura stacks on the same targeted entity if applied multiple times

attributes.name: refreshDuration
attributes.description: Makes the aura's duration refresh to the amount defined in the mechanic should the entity have the same aura applied to it again

attributes.name: mergeSameCaster
attributes.description: Merges all auras of the same name applied by one entity to another into one aura (Prevents a mob from being able to stack an aura multiple times on the same entity)
attributes.default: false if any among mergeAll, overwriteAll or overwriteSameCaster is true

attributes.name: mergeAll
attributes.description: Merges all auras of the same name applied by any and all entities to another into one aura (Prevents multiple mobs from being able to stack an aura multiple times on the same entity)

attributes.name: overwriteSameCaster
attributes.description: When applied, stops all of the same auras applied on the target by the same caster and replaces them with the new aura (cannot be used with merge options)

attributes.name: overwriteAll
attributes.description: When applied, stops all of the same auras applied on the target and replaces them with the new aura (cannot be used with merge options)

attributes.name: CancelOnGiveDamage
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura deals any damage to another entity

attributes.name: CancelOnTakeDamage
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if entity with the aura takes any sort of damage

attributes.name: CancelOnDeath
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura dies

attributes.name: CancelOnCasterDeath
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the caster of the aura dies

attributes.name: CancelOnTeleport
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura teleports at all, whether by another mechanic or server command

attributes.name: CancelOnChangeWorld
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura changes worlds. (Most times applies to players)

attributes.name: CancelOnSkillUse
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura uses another skill while the aura is active

attributes.name: CancelOnQuit
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura logs out. (Only really applies to players)

attributes.name: DoEndSkillOnTerminate
attributes.description: Whether or not the aura will run onEndSkill when it's removed by auraremove mechanic

Auraremove.description: Removes an aura from the target.

attributes.name: auraName
attributes.description: The name of the aura

attributes.name: stacks
attributes.description: The amount of stacks

Block Mask.name: Block Mask
Block Mask.description: Creates a mask of blocks around the specified target. The blocks created or changed by this effect will disappear or rather reset to their former state after the specified duration expired. Resetting the blocks at an earlier point in time can be achieved by using the blockunmask-effect (see example below).

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: The type of block used for the blockmask

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the blockmask effect

attributes.name: radiusy
attributes.description: The y component of the radius

attributes.name: noise
attributes.description: Defines the randomness of the effect

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Duration of the effect in ticks

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: The shape of the effect. Sphere/Cube

attributes.name: noair
attributes.description: Mask no air blocks only

attributes.name: onlyair
attributes.description: Mask air blocks only

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: The audience of the effect

attributes.name: occ
attributes.description: If onlyair is used, target transparent blocks as well

Block Unmask.name: Block Unmask
Block Unmask.description: The blockunmask effect is used to revert blockchanges made by the blockmask effect. For instance, this effect can be used in a high radius after a mob has died in order to “clean up” the fake block updates sent. However this is not necessary, because the fake block changes created by the blockmask effect will be reverted if a chunk is reloaded for a player (but will only revert for that player).

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the blockunmask effect

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: The shape of the effect. Sphere/Cube

Break Block And Give Item.description: Breaks the block at a target location and gives item(s). This mechanic will also drop the block (with exception of Bedrock). REQUIRES forcesync=true.

Breakblock.name: Breakblock
Breakblock.description: Will break a block at the target location. This mechanic will also drop the block (with exception of Bedrock). REQUIRES forcesync=true.

attributes.name: doDrops
attributes.description: Whether or not to drop the block/s

attributes.name: doEffect
attributes.description: Whether or not to play the break block particles

attributes.name: useTool
attributes.description: Whether or not to use the tool in the players hands

fields.name: Tests
fields.description: These tests were run using /mm test cast TestingBreakBlock When a player calls this without a tool in there hand it does not drop a block or create the particle effects. When a player calls this without a tool in there hand it does drop the block, but does not create the particle effects. The same is true if setting doEffect to false. When a player calls this with a tool in their hand it drops the block and does not play the particle effects. When a player calls this with a tool in their hand it does not drop a block, nor does it create the particle effects. When a player calls this with a tool in their hand it does drop a block, and does create the particle effects.

Cast.name: Cast
Cast.description: Cast is an Aura mechanic similar to Skill in that it executes a skill, however Cast instead "casts" the skill similar to how you'd expect an RPG hero or monster to do so. Cast will execute the given skill if the cast completes successfully (e.g. if the aura finishes normally), but can be interrupted.

attributes.name: onCastSkill
attributes.description: Skill to execute if the cast finishes successfully

attributes.name: onInterruptedSkill
attributes.description: Skill to execute if the cast is interrupted

attributes.name: onnotargetsskill
attributes.description: Skill to execute if no target is found

attributes.name: skillname
attributes.description: Display name of the spell in the cast bar

attributes.name: showCastBar
attributes.description: Whether to show the cast bar

attributes.name: cancelOnMove
attributes.description: Whether to cancel the aura if the caster moves

examples:
# This will be cast once the duration has elapsed
FrostBlast-Cast:
 Skills:
 - damage{a=20}
 - message{m="MUHAHA, TAKE THAT!"}

# This will be cast while the main casting is still in progress
FrostBlast-Tick:
 Skills:
 - particle{p=end_rod;a=4;hs=1;vs=1} @selflocation{y=1}

# This will be cast if the aura is somehow removed
FrostBlast-Interrupted:
 Skills:
 - message{m="Tsk, you got me!"}

# This will be cast if the original target for the aura no longer exist
FrostBlast-NoTargets:
 Skills:
 - message{m="...Where has everyone gone to?"} @World

Cinematic Camera.name: Cinematic Camera
Cinematic Camera.description: Plays a smooth cinematic camera path for the target player, moving their view along a series of keyframes. Useful for cutscenes, boss intros, and scripted reveals. The mechanic must target a player.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Name of a camera path defined under cutscenes/. Required if points is not set.

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: Inline keyframes, separated by ;. Wrap the value in double quotes when it has more than one keyframe, or every keyframe after the first is ignored. Alternative to path.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Total duration in ticks, split across the legs that have no hold. Only used with points; a path file sets its own.

attributes.name: easing
attributes.description: Default easing curve for legs that do not override it. Only used with points; a path file sets its own.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Whether the path repeats until cancelled. Only used with points; a path file sets its own.

attributes.name: maxDuration
attributes.description: Safety cap in ticks for looping paths, so a loop can never run forever.

attributes.name: freezePlayer
attributes.description: Makes the player invulnerable and locks their movement (walk/fly speed 0) for the duration.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: DISPLAY (smooth) or TELEPORT (per-tick teleport, no interpolation).

attributes.name: onStart
attributes.description: Skill executed when the cinematic begins. It runs with this mechanic's caster and targets, not with the player as caster.

attributes.name: onEnd
attributes.description: Skill executed when the cinematic ends. It runs with this mechanic's caster and targets, not with the player as caster.

Cinematic Cancel.name: Cinematic Cancel
Cinematic Cancel.description: Interrupts an active cinematicCamera for the target player, immediately returning their camera and control. The mechanic must target a player.

Decapitate.description: Drops a copy of the target players' head. Does nothing when used against a non-player entity.

Delay.name: Delay
Delay.description: Causes the current skilltree to be delayed by X ticks. The number of ticks can be given positionally as delay 60, or through the ticks attribute as delay{ticks=60}. Both forms accept placeholders, so the duration can be resolved at runtime, for example delay{ticks=<caster.var.x>}. Delay can also be used as an attribute directly inside of mechanics by adding the delay=TICKS universal attribute. This way, the delay is not applied to the entire skilltree but only to the single mechanic.

attributes.name: ticks
attributes.description: The number of ticks to delay the execution. Accepts placeholders.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: How the determination value is modified. Can be SET, OR, AND, NOT. Works like you would expect a boolean operation to, apart from SET that simply overrides any already defined determination value

Setstance.description: Sets the "stance" attribute of the target Mythic Mob to the given string. Does nothing if the target is not a Mythic Mob.

attributes.name: stance
attributes.description: The string-name of the stance

examples:
AnotherSkill:
 Conditions:
 - stance bowphase
 Skills:
 - ...some bow skills

Settarget.name: Settarget
Settarget.description: Sets the mob's target to the target entity. If using threat tables, will increase threat to the threshold to change targets for the targeted entity.

Settargetscore.name: Settargetscore
Settargetscore.description: Modifies the a scoreboard-objective value of the specified targeter(s). Works exactly like the ModifyTargetScore-mechanic, but is only capeable of performing the set-action.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Specifies the scoreboard objectiv to be changed. If the objective doesn't exist it will automatically be created by the mechanic

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value to perform the operation with

Settonguetarget.name: Settonguetarget
Settonguetarget.description: Sets the tongue target for a frog caster to the target entity.

Setvariable.name: Setvariable
Setvariable.description: Sets a variable. Variables can be permanent or temporary, and can be used in conjunction with conditions or placeholders to store data.

attributes.name: variable
attributes.description: The name of the variable. Can optionally be prefixed with scope

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope of the variable, e.g. where the variable will be located

attributes.name: save
attributes.description: Whether the variable should save between reloads, reboots and disconnects. Does not apply to SKILL-scoped variables

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: How long (in ticks) the variable should last. Does not apply to SKILL-scoped variables

examples:

Setvariablelocation.name: Setvariablelocation
Setvariablelocation.description: Sets a value of type string. The value will depend on the location passed to the "value" parameter, and will include informations regarding coordinates and world of the target location

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The target location

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description: Adds absorption hearts. Having maxShield as a greater value than amount is recommended.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of the shield to give

attributes.name: maxabsorb
attributes.description: The maximum value the shield on the entity should be

Shieldbreak.name: Shieldbreak
Shieldbreak.description: Breaks the target player's shield block if they are blocking. Only works when targeting players.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration in ticks that the shield will be disabled for after the block is broken

Shieldpercent.name: Shieldpercent
Shieldpercent.description: Applies an absorb shield to the target entity for a percentage of their max health.

attributes.name: multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier. The value of the shield will be maxhealth*multiplier

attributes.name: maxabsorb
attributes.description: The max value of the shield must not be greater the max health of the mob multiplied by this value

Shoot.name: Shoot
Shoot.description: Shoots an arrow or item-projectile at the targeted entity or location that deals damage. The shoot-mechanic has been significantly changed in version 2.4. See below for both how it worked prior and after those additions.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of projectile to shoot.

attributes.name: damage
attributes.description: How much damage the projectile will cause

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity of the projectile

attributes.name: maxDistance
attributes.description: The maximum distance the projectile will travel

attributes.name: poweraffectsvelocity
attributes.description: Whether the mobs power level should affect the velocity of the projectile

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: How often per second the projectile creates a tick-event

attributes.name: item
attributes.description: The item being shot. Only applicable to some projectile types

attributes.name: ontickskill
attributes.description: The meta-skill to execute on each tick/interval of the projectile

attributes.name: onhitskill
attributes.description: The meta-skill to execute when the projectile hits its target

attributes.name: onendskill
attributes.description: The meta-skill to execute when the projectile misses and ends

attributes.name: bounce
attributes.description: Whether the projectile will bounce when it hits something

attributes.name: pickup
attributes.description: Can pickup the item.

attributes.name: expiration
attributes.description: How many ticks should the projectile exist for after it has landed before it gets removed

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: Accuracy of the projectile

attributes.name: knockback
attributes.description: knockback strength of the projectile

attributes.name: piercelevel
attributes.description: The amount of times the arrow can pierce through an entity

attributes.name: verticaloffset
attributes.description: The vertical offset of the shot projectile

attributes.name: horizontaloffset
attributes.description: The horizontal offset of the shot projectile

attributes.name: forwardoffset
attributes.description: The forward offset of the shot projectile

attributes.name: sideoffset
attributes.description: The side offset of the shot projectile

attributes.name: startsideoffset
attributes.description: The side offset of the shot projectile. Yes, it is the same as the above, but this attribute has placeholder support.

attributes.name: gravity
attributes.description: Whether the projectile should be affected by gravity

attributes.name: startyoffset
attributes.description: The starting y offset of the projectile

attributes.name: adjustvelocity
attributes.description: If the caster is a player, adjusts the velocity and direction as if the player was shooting it themselves

attributes.name: calculatefiringangle
attributes.description: If this is set and the projectile has gravity, the projectile will trace an arc in the air before landing at the target location

attributes.name: verticalnoise
attributes.description: The vertical noise (randomness) of the shot projectile

attributes.name: horizontalnoise
attributes.description: The horizontal noise (randomness) of the shot projectile

attributes.name: fromorigin
attributes.description: Whether the projectile should be shot from the origin of the mechanic

Shootfireball.name: Shootfireball
Shootfireball.description: Shoots a fireball from the mob towards the target entity or location.

attributes.name: yield
attributes.description: The yield (power) of the fireball's explosion

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity of the fireball

attributes.name: fireTicks
attributes.description: How long (in ticks) fire left behind by the fireball will persist

attributes.name: incendiary
attributes.description: (true/false) Whether the fireball will leave behind fire

attributes.name: charged
attributes.description: Whether the fireball is charged

attributes.name: fromorigin
attributes.description: Whether the fireball should be shot from the origin

attributes.name: playsound
attributes.description: Whether or not to play the fireball launching sound when it is created

attributes.name: smallfireball
attributes.description: Whether or not to use the smaller blaze fireball instead of the ghast fireball

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the fireball

attributes.name: item
attributes.description: The material of the fireball, if ITEM type was used

examples:
FireballBarrage:
 Skills:
 - shootfireball{y=1;v=4} @target
 - delay 10
 - shootfireball{y=1;v=4} @target

Shootpotion.name: Shootpotion
Shootpotion.description: Throws a potion at the targeted entity or location, causing the splash potion effect of the given type to all entities hit.

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity of the thrown potion

Shootshulkerbullet.name: Shootshulkerbullet
Shootshulkerbullet.description: Shoots a shulker bullet at the target entity, giving them levitation on hit.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the bullet

attributes.name: damage
attributes.description: The damage of the bullet

attributes.name: bounce
attributes.description: Whether the bullet should bounce

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: how often in ticks this mechanic updates

attributes.name: onTick
attributes.description: the skill this mechanic calls each interval

attributes.name: onHit
attributes.description: the skill this mechanic calls when it hits the target

attributes.name: onEnd
attributes.description: the skill this mechanic calls when it ends

attributes.name: startyoffset
attributes.description: The starting y offset of the bullet

attributes.name: forwardoffset
attributes.description: The forward offset of the bullet

attributes.name: fromorigin
attributes.description: Whether to shoot the shulker bullet from the origin

TestingShootShulkerBullet:
 Skills:
 - ShootShulkerBullet{oT=TSSB_oT;oH=TSSB_oH;oE=TSSB_oE;i=1} @target
 
TSSB_oT:
 Skills:
 - particles{particle=reddust;color=#ffffff;size=0.66;a=2;hs=0;vs=0;s=0;y=0} @origin
TSSB_oH:
 Skills:
 - damage{a=5}
TSSB_oE:
 Skills:
 - particlesphere{particle=reddust;color=#ffffff;size=0.66;a=30;r=1;hs=0;vs=0;s=0;y=0} @origin

Shootskull.name: Shootskull
Shootskull.description: Shoots a wither skull from the mob towards the target entity or location.

attributes.name: yield
attributes.description: The yield (power) of the skull's explosion.

attributes.name: playsound
attributes.description: Whether or not to play the skull launching sound when it is created

examples:
SkullBarrage:
 Skills:
 - shootskull{y=1;v=4} @target
 - delay 10
 - shootskull{y=1;v=4} @target
 - delay 10
 - shootskull{y=1;v=4} @target

Show Dialog.name: Show Dialog
Show Dialog.description: Shows the target player a dialog from the dialogs folder: a window with text, items, inputs and buttons. Needs 1.21.6 or newer. On Folia, it opens on the player's region thread.

attributes.name: dialog
attributes.description: Dialog name. Case-sensitive. Supports placeholders

Showentity.name: Showentity
Showentity.description: Shows the caster, if hidden via the use of the hide mechanic, to the targeted players.

Signal.name: Signal
Signal.description: Sends a signal to the specified targeter. Won't do anything when targeted at players. The signal can be composed of any string. The mob(s) that receives the signal can only act upon it if it has a dedicated "~onSignal" trigger in its skill arsenal (see examples).

attributes.name: signal
attributes.description: The signal to send

examples:
# Mob file:
Master:
 Type: zombie
 Skills:
 - summon{m=Minion} @self ~onSpawn
 - signal{s=ATTACK} @MobsInRadius{r=10;t=Minion} ~onDamaged
Minion:
 Type: baby_zombie
 Skills:
 - skill{s=ShootAttacker} @NearestPlayer ~onSignal:ATTACK

Skill.name: Skill
Skill.description: Executes another MetaSkill, which must be located in /MythicMobs/Skills. The executed skill will inherit any targets if no targeter is specified.

attributes.name: skill
attributes.description: The metaskill to be executed

attributes.name: forcesync
attributes.description: Whether to force the skill to be run synchroniously with Minecraft

attributes.name: branch
attributes.description: Whether the called metaskill's skilltree should branch off from the skilltree of the calling mechanic. The branch will originally clone the skilltree, but any changes made to the branch will not reflect on the original skilltree

attributes.name: executeafterdeath
attributes.description: Whether the metaskill should be able to be called after the caster's death

attributes.name: snapshotcasterstats
attributes.description: Whether the caster's stats at the moment of the skill execution should be "saved in memory", so that every subsequent check/fetch operation made against them returns the saved amount. This can be useful if the metaskill includes somewhat big delays and the caster's stats can change during the metaskill execution

Skybox.name: Skybox
Skybox.description: Changes the skybox for the target players.

attributes.name: skybox
attributes.description: What skybox should be shown to the player

Slash.name: Slash
Slash.description: The Slash meta-mechanic can execute other skills in a slash-shaped pattern. The exact shape, size, location, rotation and other such elements of the slash itself can be tweaked via the attributes below.

attributes.name: onStartSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed at the start of the slash

attributes.name: onEndSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed at the end of the slash

attributes.name: onPointSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed at every point of the slash

attributes.name: onHitEntitySkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when a point of the slash hits an entity. Only triggered once per entity for every execution of the slash mechanic

attributes.name: Points
attributes.description: The amount of points in the slash

attributes.name: specificStep
attributes.description: Define a specific step/index from the generated points which should be shown, when the supplied value is greaten than 0

attributes.name: Duration
attributes.description: The amount of ticks the slash should "travel" for. A value of 0 executes an instantaneous slash

attributes.name: Width
attributes.description: The width of the slash. Increasing this value makes the slash's arc less arched

attributes.name: Height
attributes.description: The height of the slash. Increasing this value makes the slash's arc more arched

attributes.name: Angle
attributes.description: The size of the arch in degrees

attributes.name: xOffset
attributes.description: The offset on the X axis

attributes.name: yOffset
attributes.description: The offset on the Y axis

attributes.name: zOffset
attributes.description: The offset on the Z axis

attributes.name: ForwardOffset
attributes.description: Forward offset

attributes.name: targetxoffset
attributes.description: Target X-axis offset

attributes.name: targetyoffset
attributes.description: Target Y-axis offset

attributes.name: targetzoffset
attributes.description: Target Z-axis offset

attributes.name: Pitch
attributes.description: The pitch rotation

attributes.name: Yaw
attributes.description: The yaw rotation

attributes.name: Roll
attributes.description: The roll rotation

attributes.name: Radius
attributes.description: The hit radius

attributes.name: Rotation
attributes.description: The rotation of the slash, in the x,y,z format. Same as using pitch/yaw/roll

attributes.name: MatchCasterDirection
attributes.description: Matches the direction of the slash to the caster's facing direction

attributes.name: directionTowardsTarget
attributes.description: If the yaw/pitch should be calculated to aim to the target

attributes.name: FromOrigin
attributes.description: If the slash should start in the origin of the metaskill

attributes.name: HitConditions
attributes.description: List of Inline Conditions that an entity must met to be hit by the slash mechanic

Smoke.name: Smoke
Smoke.description: Creates a puff of smoke at the location of the targeter.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: The direction the effect should play towards. Can be an integer from 1 to 4

examples:
SmokeMonster:
 Type: ZOMBIE
 Skills:
 - smoke @target ~onTimer:10
 - smoke{direction=2} @self ~onAttack

Smoke Swirl.name: Smoke Swirl
Smoke Swirl.description: Creates a swirling vortex of smoke at the targeted entity or location.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: How many intervals the swirl will last

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: How many ticks there are between each pulse of smoke

Sound.name: Sound
Sound.description: Plays a sound from either the vanilla game or a resource pack at the targeted entity or location. An extensive list of sounds can be found here. Using multiple sounds stacked together can give the impression of an entirely new sound.

attributes.name: sound
attributes.description: The sound to play

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: The pitch of the sound. Can be between 0.01 and 2.0

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: The volume of the sound.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius in which the sound will be heard

attributes.name: soundcategory
attributes.description: The category at which the sound is played, useful for resourcepacks

attributes.name: emitter
attributes.description: Anchor sound playback dynamically to an entity, rather than a static location

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: The audience of the effect

Speak.name: Speak
Speak.description: Makes the caster speak using chat and speech bubbles. Supports Holograms. You can force a new line in the hologram by using \n

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: The y offset for the hologram.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of entities which will see the chat message

attributes.name: maxlinelength
attributes.description: The maximum length of the hologram

attributes.name: lineprefix
attributes.description: The prefix for the hologram.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: The message to be displayed (affects both hologram and chat)

attributes.name: chatprefix
attributes.description: The prefix for the chat message

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The amount of time the hologram will be displayed for.

attributes.name: sendchatmessage
attributes.description: Whether the message shows up in chat

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: The Audience of the mechanic

Spin.name: Spin
Spin.description: Causes the target entity to spin around for the given duration. When a mob casts the spin mechanic repeatedly it will move upwards while spinning.

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity the target spins at

Spring.name: Spring
Spring.description: Creates a temporary "spring" of liquid at the target entity or location.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of spring. Can be water or lava

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration (in ticks) the spring will last

Steal Item.name: Steal Item
Steal Item.description: Steals an item from the target and puts it in the mob's hand

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount to steal

attributes.name: dropchance
attributes.description: Sets the chance for the stolen item to be dropped upon death

attributes.name: strict
attributes.description: Whether the matcher should more strictly match the target item

attributes.name: types
attributes.description: The items to match. Can be a list

attributes.name: vanillaonly
attributes.description: Whether the matched item can only be a vanilla one

attributes.name: onStealSkill
attributes.description: The Metaskill to execute once an item is successfully stolen

Stop Sound.name: Stop Sound
Stop Sound.description: Stops a sound from playing from either the vanilla game or a resource pack for the targeted entity. A good list of sounds can be found here. Use the “sound event” column.

attributes.name: sound
attributes.description: Sound to stop playing

attributes.name: soundcategory
attributes.description: The category at which the sound is played, useful for resourcepacks

Stopusingitem.name: Stopusingitem
Stopusingitem.description: Stops the targeted living entity from using an item, i.e. blocking with a shield.
examples:
Skills:
 # basic example
 - stopusingitem @NearestPlayer
 
 # with an aura to prevent the player from using a shield
 - aura{onTick=[ - stopusingitem ?isBlocking ];duration=500} @NearestPlayer

Sudoskill.name: Sudoskill
Sudoskill.description: The SudoSkill mechanic allows you to force the targeted entity to “cast” a MythicMobs Metaskill, even if the targeted entity is a player. No single mechanics can be used straight: they have to be in a Metaskill!

attributes.name: setcasterastrigger
attributes.description: Sets the trigger of the called metaskill to the caster of this mechanic

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Sets the inherited targets of the called metaskill to the specified ones

attributes.name: chained
attributes.description: Whether to make each target of the mechanic cast the specified metaskill sequentially, each time targeting the previous caster

Suicide.name: Suicide
Suicide.description: Instantly kills the mob. This is a no-target mechanic and will only affect the casting mob. This won't work on a few non-mob entities like boats or armor stands! For them, the use of Remove is advised!

Summon.name: Summon
Summon.description: Summons mobs of the given type around the target.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of mob to summon. Can be a Mythic Mob type or a regular entity type

attributes.name: onSummon
attributes.description: The metaskill to execute on the summoned mobs

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The number of mobs to summon.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The level of the mob being summoned

attributes.name: yaw
attributes.description: The yaw of the summoned entities. If not set, will inherit the caster's

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: The pitch of the summoned entities. If not set, will inherit the caster's

attributes.name: usetargetyaw
attributes.description: Whether the yaw of the target location/entity should be used to set the yaw of the summoned entity, unless the yaw attribute is set

attributes.name: usetargetpitch
attributes.description: Whether the pitch of the target location/entity should be used to set the pitch of the summoned entity, unless the pitch attribute is set

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius around the target within which the mobs will be summoned

attributes.name: yRadius
attributes.description: Overrides the Y component of radius.

attributes.name: yRadiusUpOnly
attributes.description: Whether the Y spread should only go upward, not downward.

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The maximum initial velocity the mob will have once summoned, making the mob be propelled in a random direction

attributes.name: yvelocity
attributes.description: Same as velocity, but only applied to the y axis

attributes.name: onSurface
attributes.description: (true/false) Whether the mobs should be spawned only on a solid block

attributes.name: copyThreatTable
attributes.description: Whether the summoned mobs should copy the parent's threat table. Requires threat tables to be enabled on the summoned mob to function.

attributes.name: inheritThreatTable
attributes.description: Whether the summoned mobs should share a threat table with the parent. Requires threat tables to be enabled on the summoned mob to function.

attributes.name: inheritFaction
attributes.description: Whether the summoned mobs should have the same faction as the parent

attributes.name: inheritdespawn
attributes.description: Whether the summoned mob should inherit the caster's Despawn Option

attributes.name: summonerIsOwner
attributes.description: Whether to set the summoner as the owner of the mob.

attributes.name: summonerIsParent
attributes.description: Whether to set the summoner as the parent of the mob.

Summon Falling Block.name: Summon Falling Block
Summon Falling Block.description: Summons a falling block of the specified material at the targeted locations

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The material of the falling block

Summonareaeffectcloud.name: Summonareaeffectcloud
Summonareaeffectcloud.description: Creates a cloud of particles around the target location

attributes.name: particle
attributes.description: The particle effects to use

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the effect given by the cloud

attributes.name: potionduration
attributes.description: The duration of the potion effect

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The level of the potion effect

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration of the particle cloud

attributes.name: durationreudctiononuse
attributes.description: The duration reduction for the cloud on use

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the cloud

attributes.name: radiusreductiononuse
attributes.description: The radius reduction for the cloud on use

attributes.name: radiusreductionontick
attributes.description: The radius reduction for the cloud per tick

Summonpassenger.name: Summonpassenger
Summonpassenger.description: Summons a mob to mount the caster. Will knock the current rider off if there is one.

attributes.name: passenger
attributes.description: The type of the mob to set as the passenger

attributes.name: stack
attributes.description: Sets whether to mount the summoned entity to the current passenger of the caster

Swap.name: Swap
Swap.description: Swaps the caster and targets locations

Swing Offhand.name: Swing Offhand
Swing Offhand.description: Makes the casting player swing their offhand

Switch.name: Switch
Switch.description: A switch allows a condition to be tested against a list of (cases) values.

attributes.name: uniqueresult
attributes.description: Whether to stop execution of other skills if a condition was met

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: A condition to test for

attributes.name: cases
attributes.description: A list of cases to evaluate

Take Experience Levels.name: Take Experience Levels
Take Experience Levels.description: Takes experience levels from the targeted players

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of levels to take

Takeitem.name: Takeitem
Takeitem.description: Removes the specified amount of an item from the target player's inventory. Uses the Item Matcher

attributes.name: item
attributes.description: The item, or material, to remove

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount to remove

attributes.name: exact
attributes.description: Whether the name of the item should match exactly to the specified one

attributes.name: vanillaonly
attributes.description: Whether the matched item can only be a vanilla one

attributes.name: variable
attributes.description: The Item variable whose value is to be taken from the inventory. When set, item is ignored

Taunt.name: Taunt
Taunt.description: Modifies the threat level that the caster holds with the target entities

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: How the threat should be assigned

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: Teleports the caster to the targeted location/entity. The end point of the teleportation will be within an area whose size depends on the spreadh and spreadv attributes.

attributes.name: spreadh
attributes.description: The horizontal spread of the landing location.

attributes.name: spreadv
attributes.description: The vertical spread of the landing location.

attributes.name: preservepitch
attributes.description: Whether the pitch value should be carried over

attributes.name: preserveyaw
attributes.description: Whether the yaw value should be carried over

attributes.name: unsafe
attributes.description: Avoids finding a safe teleport (will ignore sH and sV)

Teleportin.name: Teleportin

attributes.description: The direction to where the mob will be teleported

attributes.name: yaw
attributes.description: Yaw modifier

attributes.name: targetasorigin
attributes.description: Will use the target's location as the origin instead of the caster's

Teleportto.name: Teleportto
Teleportto.description: Will teleport the targeted entity or entities to the specified location.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: The coordinates of the teleport's destination, or a targeter

attributes.name: world
attributes.description: The destination-world. Optional attribute if "location" is given

attributes.name: yaw
attributes.description: The yaw that the affected entities should assume

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: The pitch that the affected entities should assume

attributes.name: relative
attributes.description: Whether the location is relative or directional

attributes.name: targetasorigin
attributes.description: Will use the target's location as the origin instead of the caster

Teleporty.name: Teleporty

attributes.name: onterminate

attributes.description: The amount of threat to give the target. Can be negative.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The mode of the operation

Throw.name: Throw

attributes.description: The horizontal velocity at which the entity is throw

attributes.name: velocityY

attributes.description: Sets whether to throw the entity from the origin
